SH

Hi, I’m Sadiya

Hamza Bakery is a new home bakery in Hyderabad, and I am the one baking every order. I started it because I love making cakes that look pretty and taste like they were made for you.

When you message me, I read it myself, ask about the occasion, and tell you the price before anything is baked. I would rather bake fewer cakes and get each one right.

My kitchen is small and so is my menu. That is how every cake gets full attention.

  • Baked fresh for your date, not made in advance
  • Custom designs: butterfly, vintage ribbon, drip and more
  • Every price listed on this page
  • Order directly with the baker on WhatsApp
  • Pickup or delivery, your choice

Design your own cake

Fill this in and it opens WhatsApp with your details already typed. Sadiya replies with a design suggestion and the final price.

  1. Choose flavour, weight and date.
  2. Add your theme or message.
  3. Send a reference photo in the chat if you have one.
  4. Confirm the price and pay as agreed with Sadiya.

Order a day or more ahead when you can. For same-day requests, call first.
